goal: 10 verified initial case stories, then 30 across criminal, criminal procedure, civil and constitutional
requirements: Exact court, case/docket type, number, judicial year and judgment date
Official primary document and independently verified secondary provenance
Verified operative holding and procedural history
Current legal status and subsequent reversal or developments checked
Rights/privacy review and human editorial approval
No assertion of miscarriage of justice without documentary proof

candidates.story_hook: هل يستمر عقد إيجار المحل التجاري بعد وفاة المستأجر؟

candidates.story_hook: هل يمنع السن شخصًا مؤهلًا من بدء ممارسة المحاماة؟

candidates.note: منطوق الحكم عدم قبول الدعوى؛ لا توصف القضية بإثبات خطأ قضائي.
